decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory linked to the firm's installed trailer base, its survival to 2022 suggests performance is at least near aspiration while tying up little organisational slack, so we would keep it.
This box car trailer series is close to the firm's core business and, having remained on the market for several years, likely meets aspiration levels sufficiently to justify retention.

The low-bed trailer series fits the firm's production know-how and professional customer base, and continued market presence indicates acceptable results even if niche demand leaves some modest withdrawal risk.

The high trailer cover series complements existing trailer products and uses the current service and distribution network efficiently, so absent clear underperformance versus aspiration we would keep it.
